title: Calcium and Integrin-binding protein 2 (CIB2) controls force sensitivity of the mechanotransducer channels in cochlear outer hair cells
authors: Isabel Aristizábal-Ramírez; Abigail K. Dragich; Arnaud P.J. Giese; K. Sofia Zuluaga-Osorio; Julie Watkins; Garett K. Davies; Shadan E. Hadi; Saima Riazuddin; Craig W. Vander Kooi; Zubair M. Ahmed; Gregory I. Frolenkov
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CIB2突变对耳蜗毛细胞机械转导通道力敏感性的影响，虽涉及蛋白互作但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Calcium and Integrin-Binding Protein 2 (CIB2) is an essential subunit of the mechano-electrical transduction (MET) complex in mammalian auditory hair cells. CIB2 binds to pore-forming subunits of the MET channel, TMC1/2 and is required for their transport and/or retention at the tips of mechanosensory stereocilia. Since genetic ablation of CIB2 results in complete loss of MET currents, the exact role of CIB2 in the MET complex remains elusive. Here, we generated a new mouse strain with deafness-causing p.R186W mutation in Cib2 and recorded small but still measurable MET currents in the cochlear outer hair cells. We found that R186W variant causes increase of the resting open probability of MET channels, steeper MET current dependence on hair bundle deflection (I-X curve), loss of fast adaptation, and increased leftward shifts of I-X curves upon hair cell depolarization. Combined with AlphaFold2 prediction that R186W disrupts one of the multiple interacting sites between CIB2 and TMC1/2, our data suggest that CIB2 mechanically constraints TMC1/2 conformations to ensure proper force sensitivity and dynamic range of the MET channels. Using a custom piezo-driven stiff probe deflecting the hair bundles in less than 10 µs, we also found that R186W variant slows down the activation of MET channels. This phenomenon, however, is unlikely to be due to direct effect on MET channels, since we also observed R186W-evoked disruption of the electron-dense material at the tips of mechanotransducing stereocilia and the loss of membrane-shaping BAIAP2L2 protein from the same location. We concluded that R186W variant of CIB2 disrupts force sensitivity of the MET channels and force transmission to these channels.
abstract_zh: 钙整合素结合蛋白2（CIB2）是哺乳动物听觉毛细胞中机械-电转导（MET）复合体的必需亚基。CIB2与MET通道的孔形成亚基TMC1/2结合，并对其在机械感觉静纤毛尖端的运输和/或保留至关重要。由于CIB2的基因消融导致MET电流完全丧失，CIB2在MET复合体中的确切作用仍不明确。在此，我们生成了携带致聋性Cib2 p.R186W突变的新小鼠品系，并在耳蜗外毛细胞中记录到虽小但可测量的MET电流。我们发现R186W变体导致MET通道静息开放概率增加、MET电流对毛束偏转的依赖性（I-X曲线）更陡峭、快速适应丧失，以及毛细胞去极化时I-X曲线向左偏移增加。结合AlphaFold2预测R186W破坏CIB2与TMC1/2之间的多个相互作用位点之一，我们的数据表明CIB2机械性地约束TMC1/2构象，以确保MET通道的适当力敏感性和动态范围。使用定制的压电驱动硬探针在不到10微秒内偏转毛束，我们还发现R186W变体减缓了MET通道的激活。然而，这一现象不太可能归因于对MET通道的直接效应，因为我们也观察到R186W引起的机械转导静纤毛尖端电子致密物质的破坏，以及同一位置膜成形蛋白BAIAP2L2的丢失。我们得出结论，CIB2的R186W变体破坏了MET通道的力敏感性以及向这些通道的力传递。
